name: Small overruns come out of a pool
title: Small overruns come out of a pool
story: The theory first: a card that cannot pay for one more session asks. At manual and assisted you decide. You set a small monthly pool for overruns, and at autonomous and full auto the project agent may fund a small need from it; anything bigger still reaches you. Then the console: a card stops at €0.40, the factory wakes the agent, it funds €0.60 from the pool, and the card goes on.
